seo.title: The Atelier, pieces made to order | Awrea Paris
seo.description: Awrea Paris pieces are made to order, in the hands of French artisans, with care for their working conditions and for the environment. There is no stock.

chapeau: An Awrea piece begins on the day you order it. It takes shape in your size, in the hands of French artisans.

citation.texte: Each piece is made to order, far from the logic of mass production.

chapitres.texte: Your order sets the atelier to work. The piece is cut and assembled in your size, then sent to you. No shelves stacked full, no boxes of unsold pieces.

image.alt: The Aura bodysuit up close, black lace sequinned with gold and black draping knotted at the bust

citation.texte: Our designs come to life in the hands of French artisans, guardians of a precious savoir-faire.

chapitres.texte: Lace, draping and the gleam of gilding call for steady hands. Theirs, on every piece.

image.alt: The Sienna dress up close, black and gold lace at the high neck, the waist gathered to a point

citation.texte: We give essential attention to working conditions and to the recognition of these crafts, convinced that the beauty of a piece is also born of the ethics that accompany it.

chapitres.texte: The weeks between your order and its dispatch are the weeks of making. They give the artisans time to do things well.

image.alt: The Odessa dress up close, black bustier with straps and a black lace waist

citation.texte: This choice lies at the heart of our vision: to produce only what is desired, with awareness and respect for the environment. There is no stock, only creations designed for the person who wears them.

chapitres.texte: A piece that is ordered is a piece awaited, then worn. Nothing is produced to sleep in a storeroom.

image.alt: The Gaïa bodysuit up close, black jersey with bands of black lace set on the bias

fin.texte: From order to delivery, every step of the making can be followed in your account.
